messages:
lia (people-ops): quick pack for managers — 3 tiny templates you can paste into self-review prompts, 1:1s, and peer feedback requests. keeping it short: Focus + Evidence + Next step.

sam (eng-manager): love it. can you drop a couple one-liners i can copy into 1:1 notes?

lia (people-ops): sure — here are three variants (pick depending on seniority / formality):

1) Focus framing (goal-oriented):
`Goal: Improve model latency at 95th pct by 15%`
`Evidence: Reduced median tail from 320ms -> 270ms under prod traffic; added KV caching for common prefixes`
`Next step: Roll quantized v2 to canary & measure end-to-end p95 over 2 weeks`

2) Impact-first (product-facing):
`Focus: Make API calls 20% cheaper by batching and cache hits`
`Evidence: Batching pilot cut tokens billed by 12% on nightly job; customer X saw 10% cost drop`
`Next: Expand batching to chat route, add regression checks`

3) Growth / career cue (developmental):
`Focus: Level up infra design and cross-team leadership`
`Evidence: Led design review for routing policy and mentored 2 ICs`
`Next: Own a cross-team rollout and publish runbook`

arjun (ml-eng): can we get a 30s peer-feedback prompt for teammates? want something non-awkward for async asks.

lia (people-ops): yep — try this paste: `Hey <name>, could you share 1-2 quick sentences about a time I handled ambiguity well and 1 area I could improve? No need for long examples — just one concrete moment + suggested next step.`

sam (eng-manager): perfect. also any guidance for OKR language? our ICs always struggle to make measurable KR.

lia (people-ops): KR quick-check: answer these 3 in the KR line: "Who benefits? What metric moves? By how much? When?" Example: `KR: Reduce inference p95 for /chat by 15% (from 320ms to <=272ms) during Q2 by deploying batching + prefix cache.`

marta (people-ops): timeline note — performance reviews open next Monday. please push prompts to your teams this week so self-reviews arrive before calibration. people-bot will post reminders.

people-bot: Reminder set — automated DM to all managers on 1934567950 and daily nudges at 10:00 for 5 days. :bell:

sam (eng-manager): thanks — i'm going to paste the 3 variants into my 1:1 template and nudge the team. small ask: can we get a printable 1-pager later?

lia (people-ops): yes — i'll assemble a single-page PDF with copy-and-paste snippets and a mini checklist. will share in #people-ops by EOD Friday. :sparkles:

arjun (ml-eng): saved — nice concise stuff, will use the growth variant for my self-review.

sam (eng-manager): adding a quick note for calibration: include quantitative evidence lines only (links to dashboards or PRs). helps a lot.

lia (people-ops): agreed. when you paste the template, add a line `Evidence links: <URL1>, <URL2>` so reviewers can click straight through.

marta (people-ops): thanks everyone — small, high-signal changes. happy to iterate if folks find gaps after the first round.
